name: Silverfall Reach
difficulty_label: Hard: cascade currents, skaters and the Sluicewarden
description: A misty river kingdom shaped by ferrymen and river-stone masons. Explore Reed’s oar-lined hearth, the Canopy Tea Room and Mistkeeper Observatory; cross sculpted bridges, willow gardens and silver cascades. Both shore routes and the ferry connect. Find the hidden springs, clear the defenders, then face the Crowned Torrent.
